project.name: xander-auth-core
project.description:
Auth core (V9 §20): the trusted-identity model and the access-token verifier, shared by every service including the WebFlux Gateway.
Contents: - UserContext : the request-scoped identity holder (userId + client IP). - JwtUtil : access / refresh / bind token generation and verification.
Allowed here (V9 §20): JWT claim model, access token verifier, auth policy model, trusted identity model. Forbidden here (V9 §20): HandlerInterceptor, WebMvcConfigurer, Gateway Filter, RedisHealthMonitor. Must stay Servlet / Reactive neutral.
Deliberate non-members, and why: - AuthInterceptor -> xander-webmvc-support. It is a HandlerInterceptor, which V9 §20 forbids here by name. - PasswordEncoderConfig -> stays on the application. It is a @Configuration wiring spring-security-crypto's BCrypt bean, i.e. MVC-side infrastructure, and V9 §20 does not list it.
Warning, recorded rather than resolved: UserContext is a ThreadLocal holder. It has zero framework dependencies, so it is neutral in the dependency sense, but a ThreadLocal is a Servlet way to carry request identity and does NOT work under WebFlux, where a request can move between threads. A reactive consumer must not use it and needs the identity threaded through the Reactor context instead. V9 §20 names "trusted identity model" as belonging in this lib and this is the existing model, so the caveat is documented here for whoever builds the Wave 1 Gateway rather than hidden by leaving the class in a business domain package.
